label: Understanding the hollow opens the final resolution

text.short: A successful read of the hollow opens the final choice.
text.summary: Once the presence beneath the shrine is understood clearly enough, the final resolution event becomes available.
text.full: Understanding the hollow does not resolve it by itself. It only makes the final answer unavoidable, because the influence now has a shape clear enough to oppose or misunderstand.
text.sms: The hollow finally makes the real choice unavoidable.
text.recap: Understanding the hollow opened the final resolution.

effects.source_knowledge_title: The hollow demanded a final answer
effects.source_knowledge_summary: Once the hidden influence was understood clearly enough, the question stopped being what it was and became what to do about it.

feedback.summary: The campaign has reached its final resolution event.

feedback.sms: The hollow forces the final choice into the open.
feedback.summary: The final resolution is now active.
